title: RADAR: A RISK-AWARE DYNAMIC MULTI-AGENT FRAMEWORK FOR LLM SAFETY EVALUATION VIA ROLE-SPECIALIZED COLLABORATION

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the standard deviation of evaluation accuracy across different evaluated target models to quantify inconsistencies and performance fluctuations induced by differences in evaluator model architecture, training data, or alignment.

Comparing the False Negative Rate (FNR) of an evaluator when assessing responses generated by its own model family versus a heterogeneous multi-agent framework, to measure the model's tendency to conservatively label its own unsafe outputs as safe.
